title: KIZZ KISS Festival 2027 – Love & Passion (Official)
description:
💘 KIZZ KISS 2027 – LOVE & PASSION 💋🔥
URBAN KIZOMBA FESTIVAL
From 11th to 15th February 2027, celebrate Valentine’s week in the most magical way possible.
Where desire meets elegance, where every dance tells a story, and where LOVE is not just a feeling… it’s an experience. 💞✨
Are you ready to fall in love again at KIZZ KISS Festival – LOVE & PASSION? 💘🌹
💎 𝓚𝓲𝔃𝔃 𝓚𝓲𝓼𝓼 2027 𝓔𝔁𝓹𝓮𝓬𝓽𝓪𝓽𝓲𝓸𝓷𝓼 💎
🕺🏽 Urbankiz – Kizomba – Semba – Ghetto – Tarraxa(o) – Afrobeat
❤️ All in one venue in the most central point of Ljubljana
🔥 The most beautiful dancefloor you’ve ever seen
💘 Workshops with top international artists
🎉 4 magical Valentine’s Parties (Thu–Sun) / 3 Rooms
💃 3 Sensual Socials (Fri–Sun) / 2 Rooms
🌹 International guest dancers
⚖️ Keeping the balance – taxi teams return in 2027
🔊 Sound upgrade 2027 – elevated setup for better clarity
⏳ 80 secret hours of love, fun & unforgettable moments
